Contact Openink Hub

Tell us what you're trying to grow, and we'll show you exactly how we can help.

Whether you already know which service you need — SEO, HRMS, WhatsApp automation, or Social Media Optimization — or you're not sure where to start, this is the fastest way to reach our team and get a plan tailored to your business.

Quick answer: To contact Openink Hub, use the enquiry form on this page and tell us what you want to grow. Whether you need SEO, HRMS, WhatsApp automation or social media, the team will point you to the right service and share a plan tailored to your business.

How we can take your services

From first message to a live, working system

Here's exactly what happens after you reach out — no guesswork about what onboarding with Openink Hub looks like.

01

You tell us what you need

Fill out the form below, email us, or call directly. Share your business type, current challenges, and which services you're considering — SEO, GMB, WhatsApp automation, HRMS, or Social Media Optimization.

02

We assess & recommend a plan

Our team reviews your current setup — website, socials, or internal processes — and comes back with a specific recommendation, not a generic pitch, usually within 1–2 business days.

03

We walk you through it live

A short call or demo where we show the relevant dashboard, explain pricing, and answer every question before you commit to anything.

04

Onboarding & setup

Once you're ready, we handle account provisioning, integrations (Google, Meta, WhatsApp, your CMS), and initial configuration — typically live within 24–48 hours.

05

Ongoing support & reporting

You get a dedicated point of contact, regular performance reporting, and continuous optimization — not a one-time handoff.

Before you reach out

Quick answers

How soon will I hear back?

Within one business day for most enquiries. Phone and WhatsApp messages during working hours are usually answered same-day.

Do I need to know exactly which service I want?

Not at all. Tell us your goal — more traffic, more local customers, faster HR, better engagement — and we'll recommend the right service.

Is the initial consultation free?

Yes. The first call or demo is free and comes with no obligation to sign up.

How fast can we actually get started?

Most accounts are provisioned and live within 24–48 hours of onboarding, depending on the service and any third-party approvals needed (like WhatsApp API access).
